# Mineralys Therapeutics to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 03, 2026 4:05 pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_c197f627fd9971ac0bd4ef9581b282ed/mineralystx/news/2026-11-03_Mineralys_Therapeutics_to_Participate_in_Upcoming__126.pdf)


RADNOR, Pa., Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: MLYS), a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and aldosterone-related adverse outcomes in comorbid conditions such as chronic kidney disease, obstructive sleep apnea and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone, today announced that members of senior management will be participating in fireside chats at three upcoming investor conferences.


**Guggenheim Healthcare Innovation Conference**


Date: Tuesday, November 10, 2026


Time: 2:30pm ET


Format: Fireside Chat


[Webcast Link](https://event.summitcast.com/view/oVDtKqmPn2tPc7VV7WsLAC/guest_book?session_id=WePnpyK8MSJVsf4NaiAQmw)


**Stifel Healthcare Conference**


Date: Thursday, November 12, 2026


Time: 8:40am ET


Format: Fireside Chat


[Webcast Link](https://event.summitcast.com/view/4aFtJriVa3BvDmNqmfSxma/guest_book?session_id=JYeB6GRC6VLbEa28PFmRFs)


**9** **th** **Annual Evercore Healthcare Conference**


Date: Tuesday, December 1, 2026


Time: 1:45pm ET


Format: Fireside Chat


[Webcast Link](https://event.summitcast.com/view/FkwyWrnNgoveMhBfJS2NCC/CqigpGCKpheCGA5CKsMHuV)


The live webcasts and archives of these fireside chats can also be accessed on the “[News & Events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=CfR_IninUE1XeqXlah6rr7FxlEWRv8ky1XQzKkArWAP0zRH3zneXriTZP_aqJLOYWjD9n_rsjD5wCklA8bxDrle4Fu4inrYVZ9YCNGoYjkAh-s1gVe4ziM9v33KtM6r4) ” page in the Investor Relations section of the Mineralys Therapeutics website.


**About Mineralys**
Mineralys Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease, obstructive sleep apnea and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is an investigational, proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is based in Radnor, Pennsylvania, and was founded by Catalys Pacific.
